summary: Cessna 210B N9568X suffered engine failure after departing Blake Field (Delta) for Casper, WY; hard forced landing next to highway near Cedaredge; post-impact fire; pilot Tyler Beyer (35) and passenger Jessica Beyer (33) pulled from wreckage by witnesses with serious injuries.
location: near Cedaredge, Grand Mesa (Hwy 65 near Ward Lake)
responding_agency: Delta County Sheriff's Office, Delta County Search and Rescue, Delta County Ambulance District, Cedaredge Fire Department
notes: Both victims transported to St. Mary's Medical Center, Grand Junction; Delta County SAR provided scene security; names per NTSB/Kathryn's Report (widely published).
